_rule: Each planted fault lists the full SET of FAIL check-names it must produce. A fire test passes only if the observed set of '^FAIL <check>' names equals 'expect' and the exit code equals 'exit'. The plant's target check is mandatory. If the first run shows a different extra name, the set may be corrected once, with the reason in 'corrected', never by dropping the target. 'optional' (unplanted control runs only) lists names that may appear because of a known intermittent defect in the old code; they are never required and never cover a target.
